headline: New Tensions Push Up Oil Prices: Will They Affect Fuel Prices in BiH?
summary: Rising oil prices are expected to affect retail fuel prices in Bosnia and Herzegovina, alongside transport costs, the US dollar exchange rate and tax burdens.
why: Retail fuel prices in small import-dependent markets follow global crude and currency movements, which affects household budgets and inflation.
